name: Vampire Hearts Forever
source:
In the war against vampires, you’re the one who turns the tides. Thanks to your natural ability to detect vampires by their scent alone, you’ve found your way onto the top team of hunters—a duo known as Ezra and Grant, the strongest around.

The two have been by your side for a couple years now, and the three of you work like a well-oiled machine, trudging from hideout to hideout, a trail of dead vampires in your wake. Though you believe that not all vampires are evil, your teammates don’t see it like that… Until an uncovered secret threatens to upend everything the three of you have ever known.

When the end comes, will you continue to side with what’s comfortable, or will you stand for what’s right?

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.genius.unhuman]Google Play[/url]]
translation:
在与吸血鬼的战争中，你是扭转局势的人。由于你天生就有能力仅通过气味来发现吸血鬼，你已经找到了进入顶尖猎人队伍的道路——这对组合被称为埃兹拉和格兰特，是周围最强的。

这两个人已经在你身边好几年了，你们三个就像一台运转良好的机器一样工作，从一个藏身处艰难地走到另一个藏身处，身后跟着一串死去的吸血鬼。尽管你相信并非所有吸血鬼都是邪恶的，但你的队友并不这么认为……直到一个未揭开的秘密威胁到你们三个所知道的一切。

当末日到来时，你会继续站在让你舒服的一边，还是会坚持正义？

[来自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.genius.unhuman]Google Play[/url]]
